description:
A Nikke belonging to Underworld Queen who is also the head of a yakuza group known as the Seimeikai.
A woman of principle, the Seimeikai refrain from engaging in immoral acts thanks to her leadership. Under her guidance, the Seimeikai has become an organization with a well-deserved reputation for its honorable conduct.

lines.text: At the end of the day, organizations are made up of humans, who should be treated with dignity.
What do you want from me this time?
If you want the support of the organization, you'll need to win me over first.
All that is yours, is mine. Never forget that.
You're free to have tea with me anytime...
Would you like to go see the cherry blossoms in the garden?
Since you're leaving me here standing, I assume you're taking time to compose a haiku?
It's nice spending a quiet moment with you.
I'm expanding my knowledge and looking into the organization you're a part of.
It's nice to get out sometimes.
Apparently there is a court here, but in name only. Any semblance of justice in this place rests in your own hands.
I am Sakura, head of Saimaikai. If you are willing to accept the assistance of the underworld, I will gladly give it.
I will remember this.
Are you starting to trust me?
It won't do us any harm to be overprepared.
Why would you give this to me? On second thought, I'll accept it gladly.
You're not doing this just to get into my good books, are you?
You truly are a kind person.
I hope that I'm the only recipient of your love.
You always catch me off guard like this.
Since our bond has deepened, perhaps the flavor of our tea will follow likewise.
Very well, I will lend you the organization's power.
I'm here.
On my way.
Time to take out the trash.
I'll settle this according to our own rules.
Those without sense of duty are punished.
By Saimaikai, these fiends will go no further.
Can you buy me some time?
Trust me.
No time to waste.
You and me, right now.
We are Saimaikai. We see all.
The time has come to end this strife.
Easy.
Next.
We're on a roll. Let's keep going.
Ah!
Too many.
Uh.
I'm sorry I didn't see this through.
The organization will be proud of this outcome.
